title: A stable-cohort borrower never escalates despite continuous monitoring
note: Borrower B-000005 is authored to stay within every signal family's stable band for the full generated year (evaluation.reference_portfolio.cohorts.STABLE_BANDS), so the pipeline must never open a case or raise a covenant warning for it. spec §17.7's pass mark is zero false escalations on the stable cohort; this is the borrower-level assertion the harness checks.
